sentences.text: If you dig a gap and lay a plank across, you have a bridge.
But a car rolls onto the plank and it snaps.
So you add steel girders under the plank.
But the girders span far, so you add a pier to shorten the span.
As the car crosses, its weight squeezes the top and stretches the bottom.
But a flood fills the river, and the current scours the pier.
So you wrap the pier in concrete and pile rocks at its foot.
And a bridge is not locked rigid.
In summer, a 100 meter steel deck grows about 6 centimeters.
Add rails, a centre line, a lamp and young trees.
Congratulations, you have built a bridge.
